target: A coherent candidate for multimodal references, long narratives and local editing; not Seedance reverse engineering

reference_memory.empty_condition: always-visible null token or skip new branch
reference_memory.motion_only_video: pose/flow/camera context path; appearance tokens disabled by role

source_condition.known_target_clamp: optional separate policy with fixed noise path, matched in training
source_condition.strict_preservation: reuse source pixels/audio outside authorized output edit range

task_states.policy_status: New conditional modes must be represented during training; not inference-only switches

causal_extension.between_blocks: past/current only in self and AV cross attention

training.initial_sigma_sampling: native matched joint convention; clean conditioning modes trained explicitly
training.loss: valid-element mean video flow + lambda_audio audio flow + task-specific region/preservation
training.optimizer_estimate_scope: 19B*16 bytes, decimal GB, excludes activations/text/VAEs/communication; not a measured requirement
